crm_notes: Existing Tier-1 regional carrier; primary interest is Private (air-gapped) deployment for operator/incident workflows. Key quote from Head of Security: "model outputs must never egress to public internet and telemetry must be controllable". Wants customer-managed KMS + HSM, SIEM integration (Splunk), long-term audit log retention and per-route cost accounting. Workload: mixture of natural-language operator assist (chat) and doc search for internal runbooks; occasional automated config synthesis for network devices (pre-change suggestions). Latency SLO: interactive operator flows ~150ms token time target, throughput peaky (bursts up to ~50 RPS during incidents). Model preference: open/model weights that can be quantized and pinned, fallback to smaller distilled model for degraded hardware. Critical blockers: procurement asking for FedRAMP equivalency letter; legal wants explicit indemnity for on-prem license; facilities team must confirm POC rack/network. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for guaranteed isolation and support SLA. Reference artifacts: security deck + air-gap KMS design in Drive.

use_case_summary: Goal: on-prem/air-gapped LLM to accelerate operator response and internal knowledge retrieval. Primary workloads: operator chat (interactive assist), runbook/doc search, and automated config suggestion. Requirements: strict data residency, HSM-backed keys, offline model weights, predictable throughput with burst handling, and fallback to compact model when GPUs limited. Deployment: private control plane with on-prem inference nodes, racks fenced off from internet, Splunk log forwarding, and SSO/SAML integration. Success criteria: can run a 2-week air-gapped POC with real runbooks, meet security checklist items, demonstrate <200ms interactive response baseline and stable behavior during 50 RPS bursts.
